newsitem.title: USA: Marion County, Fla., to delay school tax vote.
newsitem.headline: Marion County, Fla., to delay school tax vote.

text.p: Florida's Marion County Commission rejected school officials' request for a June referendum on a half-cent sales tax to fund school construction, the Ocala Star Banner said Friday.

The council said turnout was likely to be low in the summer when many voters were out of town. School Superintendent John Smith said the school board hoped to put the proposal on the ballot in the fall, possibly as soon as Sept. 2.
A community task force recommended that the school district seek approval for the school cpaital outlay surtax, which Florida authorized in 1995, to fund $180 milion of capital needs.
